title: Training-Free Hidden-State Refinement for Flow-Matching Image Generators
abstract: arXiv:2608.29160v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We aim to improve frozen flow-matching image generators by adding inference computation inside the denoiser, without changing model weights or the outer sampler. Existing generators usually spend extra test-time computation by increasing the number of sampling steps, which repeatedly evaluates the entire denoiser and couples quality gains to sampler cost. A key challenge is how to use extra computation inside a frozen transformer denoiser: the method must decide which tokens, layers, and sampling times receive repeated updates while preserving the original generation pipeline. We introduce a training-free looping framework that repeatedly applies selected transformer layers inside each denoising call. translated_title: 面向流匹配图像生成器的免训练隐状态细化
translated_abstract: 我们旨在通过在去噪器内部添加推理计算来改进冻结的流匹配图像生成器，且不改变模型权重或外部采样器。现有生成器通常通过增加采样步数来消耗额外的测试时计算，这会重复评估整个去噪器，并将质量提升与采样器成本耦合在一起。一个关键挑战是如何在冻结的 transformer 去噪器内部使用额外计算：该方法必须决定哪些 token、哪些层以及哪些采样时刻接受重复更新，同时保持原始生成管线不变。我们引入了一个免训练的循环框架，在每个去噪调用内部重复应用选定的 transformer 层。其中，密集与稀疏 Token 循环改变 token 范围；采样进度门控和循环层范围指定循环在何时何处激活；循环次数与强度控制重复更新的幅度；循环引导则将普通输出与循环输出相结合，从而在不重训练模型的情况下提升生成质量。
tldr: 提出一种免训练的循环框架，在冻结的流匹配去噪器内部重复应用选定的 transformer 层来细化隐状态，从而在不改变模型权重和外部采样器的前提下提升图像生成质量。
en_tdlr: A training-free looping framework that repeatedly applies selected transformer layers inside each denoising call to refine hidden states, improving frozen flow-matching image generators without changing model weights or the outer sampler.
